title: WG feedback: send spec errata and suggestions
description: Get the accumulated wg beads (label wg + spec:<doc>) to the standards bodies the Right Way. Channels: MIMI drafts via their GitHub repos (ietf-wg-mimi/draft-ietf-mimi-content, ietf-wg-mimi/mimi-room-policy, ietf-wg-mimi/mimi-arch, ietf-wg-mimi/mimi-protocol (bifurcation/ietf-mimi-protocol redirects here) plus mimi@ietf.org; MLS drafts via mlswg/mls-extensions and mlswg/mls-ratchet-tree-options plus mls@ietf.org; test vectors via mlswg/mls-implementations; RFC 9420 errors only via the RFC Editor errata form (suggestions go to mls@ietf.org). Editorial items: one bundled PR per draft. Technical items: one GitHub issue each plus a short list message (technical discussion belongs on the list). Mark sends under his own name (IETF contributions are personal, Note Well); every external send needs Mark's explicit per-action OK. Offer mimid for an RFC 7942 Implementation Status section. Timing: protocol-06 expires 2026-10-27.
